title: Counting vectors above the cutoff
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be the specified typical polynomial threshold cutoff for $n$. The number of sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$ having more than $c$ positive coordinates equals the number of subsets of an $n$-element set whose cardinality is greater than $c$.
